prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Houston, Texas. Injury: shoulder injury. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1045; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a busy Houston street when the car behind me struck the rear of my vehicle. The impact was hard enough to jolt me forward and back against the seat. Right away I felt a sharp pain in my right shoulder, and I have been dealing with stiffness and limited movement since. I am the policyholder listed on this policy, and I was driving my own vehicle at the time. When I went over what happened again afterward, I remembered a few more small details, such as the traffic and the other driver's position, but the core of my account has not changed from what I first reported. I have kept my medical notes and photos of the damage, and I am willing to provide them for review.
